metadata.title: chore: update pr-review skill and remove duplicate config schemas
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary
- Update the pr-review skill to fetch+rebase against origin/main before reviewing, with conflict resolution guidance
- Add targeted lint auto-fix (autoflake/isort/black scoped to changed files only) instead of report-only lint findings
- Remove duplicate `docs/config.schema.json` and `docs/docs/config.schema.json` (housekeeping)

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify pr-review skill loads correctly via `/pr-review`
- [ ] Confirm `make autoflake isort black TARGET=...` works with the documented one-liner

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The TARGET generation for the auto-fix command can break in common cases: (1) if the PR touches no .py files, it expands to an empty TARGET and `make autoflake/isort/black` will likely fail; (2) `git diff --name-only` can include deleted paths, which would also cause formatter failures. Consider guarding on an empty file list (skip auto-fix) and filtering out deletions (e.g., via a diff-filter) so the one-liner is safe for non-Python or delete-only changes.
```suggestion
PY_FILES="$(git diff --diff-filter=d --name-only origin/main -- '*.py')"
if [ -n "$PY_FILES" ]; then
  make autoflake isort black TARGET="$PY_FILES"
fi
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The "Rules" section allows modifying files only via `make black` / `make isort`, but the preceding "Lint auto-fix" section explicitly requires auto-fixing with `autoflake` as well and provides a `make autoflake isort black ...` command. Update the rules to include the full set of permitted auto-fix commands (or adjust the earlier section) to avoid contradictory guidance.
```suggestion
- **Do not modify files** except for targeted lint auto-fixes (`make autoflake
  TARGET=...`, `make isort TARGET=...`, `make black TARGET=...`). Report all
  other findings for the author to address.
```

commits.message:
chore: update pr-review skill with rebase-first and targeted lint auto-fix

Add fetch+rebase against origin/main as the first review step, with
conflict resolution guidance (.secrets.baseline keeps incoming version).

Replace report-only lint findings with auto-fix using targeted make
commands (autoflake/isort/black scoped to changed .py files only).

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
